class_mod: +3 STR, +1 DEX, +4 INT (wiki Wizard Creation Guide)

mana.text: Your mana stat is whichever of INT or WIS is higher (wiki Statistics); 110 of 121 wiki Wizard spells cost mana.
mana.label: FACT

wiki_advice: Below is the recommended allocation of bonus points by race. Since Intelligence is a Wizard’s main attribute, you should focus on maximizing it whenever possible. Your spell damage and mana total is directly tied to it. After that, prioritize Dexterity. It affects hit rate across the board and increases your proc chance. Finally, put some points into Stamina for extra HP and a bit of stun resistance. Dwarf: +1 Stamina, +2 Dexterity, and +7 Intelligence Gnome: +3 Stamina, +2 Dexterity, and +5 Intelligence Human: +1 Stamina, +2 Dexterity, and +7 Intelligence

builds.name: Survivor
builds.why: Wizards are fragile and mana-hungry (official); more HP for solo play; this is exactly the wiki Gnome allocation.

builds.why: Biggest nukes and pool in groups.

build_caveat: Point totals are from the wiki race pages (10 bonus points for every listed race/class). Whether a stat has a per-point cap or diminishing returns at creation is not documented on the wiki: UNVERIFIED.

traits.why: Intelligent: +5% INT and a 15-second +50% INT burst.
Evocation is the biggest Wizard school on the wiki (52 of 121): direct damage and stuns.
Readiness gives a Cantrip slot from level 1, so one memorized spell survives death.

Miner starts Mining at 25 with a Trainee's Mining Pick and Pouch, matching the default gathering setup (Mining, Lumberjacking, Smelting) for early coin. Medic (Bind Wound 25 and bandages) is the safer pick if you expect downtime between fights. Blacksmith exists but smithing stays off by default here.

trait_caveat: Trait text and race/class limits are from Template:Traits; picks that your race cannot take are swapped automatically in the race note. Which trait is 'best' is STRATEGY; no sourced numbers compare them.
